summary.en: Boulevard City's musical fountain: jets in four set pieces lit in colour at night, with fire columns and smoke, in a 19 m stone basin of water with jet lights. The spray runs on High with WebGPU; elsewhere the basin, its water and its lights draw.
summary.ar: نافورة بوليفارد سيتي الموسيقية: نفاثات في أربعة عروض ملوّنة بالضوء ليلًا، مع أعمدة نار ودخان، في حوض حجري بقطر 19 م مملوء بالماء وبأضواء النفاثات. يعمل الرذاذ على الجودة العالية مع WebGPU، وفي غيرها يُرسم الحوض وماؤه وأضواؤه.

source.symbol: spray (main.js 1401-1445: compute particles, four set pieces, fire, smoke), stepped by main.js 1578

defaults.note: main.js spray: N = 4000 drops from a ring of jets (r 2.6-2.9 m) and a centre jet; set piece = floor(time / 8) mod 4 (arcs, tall centre, rotating wave, wide fans); centre jets 15 m/s up, 22 m/s in the tall-centre piece (22^2 / (2 x 9.81) = 24.67 m: jetHeight); lit colours mix(vec3(0.2, 0.55, 1.0), vec3(1.0, 0.25, 0.7), sin(0.4 t)) and vec3(0.3, 1.0, 0.7) every other 8 s, x 2.2 at night (uNight), water vec3(0.78, 0.88, 0.95) by day; sprite scale 0.55, opacity 0.1 x a soft disc, faded out 90-150 m; fire: 8 columns x 70 sprites 6.5 m out, on for the first 7% of each 24 s; smoke 8 x 24 sprites after it. High and WebGPU only (main.js 1403). Boulevard has no basin: the 9.5 m kerbstone basin with water at 0.30 m and its eight 120 lm jet lights are ours (builder/sculpt/basin.js).

made_by: 3DPLAT (Boulevard City fountain show, effect module; basin a sculpt module from Boulevard's kerbstone and water)
